These are deliberately null rather than plausible guesses. A guessed property name
would make the pipeline appear to work while producing wrong numbers, which is the
one outcome the brief rules out. The pipeline checks for nulls and reports HubSpot
as unavailable rather than falling back to a guess.
Fill these in from the output of: node scripts/discover-hubspot.mjs
_attributionModeComment: One of 'traced' or 'aggregate'. Set to 'traced' only when a reliable lead level join key is confirmed at or above the joinKeyReliableFillPct threshold. Anything else stays 'aggregate' and the dashboard labels the affected metrics as period counts rather than traced cohorts.
